name: Joshua D. Schein

about: Licensed to practice in California and New York, Joshua D. Schein is the founding attorney of Schein Law Group in Los Angeles, California. He represents clients with a range of matters in employment litigation, business law and general litigation.

Mr. Schein has over 15 years of experience in employment litigation, complex commercial disputes, and business litigation. He has provided legal representation to diverse clientele, including individuals and employees who have experienced injustice at the hands of their employers, as well as large corporations and affluent individuals.

With a bachelor’s degree in political science with honors, and a bachelor's degree in English, from the University of California at Berkeley, Mr. Schein received his Juris Doctor from the UCLA School of Law. Mr. Schein established Schein Law Group with the aim of delivering excellent legal services to both employees and businesses, while ensuring efficient prices and outstanding outcomes.

Mr. Schein's dedication to employee rights is evident in his track record of successfully litigating against corporate giants and securing large settlements and verdicts for his clients. Mr. Schein's deep understanding of labor laws and his ability to navigate complex legal systems make him a formidable advocate for those seeking justice in the face of corporate misconduct.

A native of Los Angeles, Mr. Schein possesses vast experience in advocating for employees and individuals who have suffered injustices at the hands of corporations. Throughout his professional journey, he has wholeheartedly committed himself to safeguarding the rights of employees.

Active in the legal field, Mr. Schein is a member of the American Bar Association, the Los Angeles County Bar Association, the Beverly Hills Bar Association, and the New York Bar Association. He has served as a speaker for the Los Angeles Paralegal Association (LAPA) on two occasions. He was the final speaker at the LAPA annual conference in 2015. Additionally, he has delivered lectures on employment law, social media law and legal ethics as part of the Certified Legal Education program.
